gymnastics [ edit ] Main article: Rhythmic gymnastics at the 1984 Summer Olympics Rowing [ edit ] Main article: Rowing at the 1984 Summer Olympics There were eight competitions for men and Spain qualified four boats, but had no women competing in 1984. [ 2 ] Although he had competed at the 1980 Summer Olympics , [ 3 ] Manuel Vera Vázquez was still the youngest competitor of the Spanish rowing team. [ 2 ] The coxless pair of Fernando Climent and Luis María Lasúrtegui was a surprise medallist, and as of 2016 , the team's silver medal is the only Olympic rowing medal that the nation has ever won.
